name: Brasil
caution: Edible when fully black and soft; the thorns are serious. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A dense thorny brush-country shrub, also called bluewood, whose tiny black fruit is sweet and a little tart.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: Gathered in quantity it makes a dark jelly; on the trail it is a welcome sweet in dry country.
